name: Oriental Shiraishi Corporation
summary: Oriental Shiraishi Corporation produces, constructs, and sells prestressed concrete products and structures in Japan. It operates through three segments: Construction Business, Steel Structure Business, and Port Business. The Construction business segment engages in construction work and manufacturing/sales of prestressed concrete civil engineering structures, pneumatic caissons; repair and reinforcement work for bridges, prestressed concrete building structures; and design and construction, design and production of construction equipment, civil engineering contracting, and rental of construction machinery.
